code_slices.fixed: Fixed __bpf_get_stackid computes max_depth with stack_map_calculate_max_depth() and uses min_t(u32, trace->nr - skip, max_depth - skip).
code_slices.surrounding_context: A stack_map_bucket has flexible u64 data[] storage, and stack-map trace depth is constrained by map layout.
code_slices.vulnerable: Pre-fix __bpf_get_stackid derives trace_nr as trace->nr - skip without a layout-capacity clamp.

causal_trace.summary: A raw-tracepoint BPF execution reaches the stack-ID helper with perf stack-trace data.
Before the fix, trace_nr was computed as trace->nr minus skip without constraining the post-skip count to the stack-map bucket capacity derived from map layout.
The resulting stack-trace data copy in __bpf_get_stackid writes past the bucket data array when the trace has more entries than the bucket can hold.
KASAN observed an eight-byte slab out-of-bounds write in __bpf_get_stackid at kernel/bpf/stackmap.c:265.

failure.operation: Write of an eight-byte stack instruction-pointer entry beyond a stack-map bucket's data array during __bpf_get_stackid processing.

primary_invariant.statement: The number of post-skip instruction-pointer entries stored in a stack-map bucket must not exceed the maximum depth implied by the map value size, element size, and flags.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The pre-fix calculation used trace->nr - skip directly, so it could exceed the layout-derived maximum bucket depth.

quality.review_notes: The bundle directly supplies an upstream patch and a KASAN crash excerpt, and the issue page reports successful retest-repro outcomes. No direct ReproC/ReproSyz, build configuration, raw successful retest log, or dedicated regression-test source is present; exact BPF inputs, required privileges, and exploitability are therefore not asserted.

remediation.invariant_restored: The fix calculates max_depth from map value size, stack-map element size, and flags, then clamps trace_nr to max_depth - skip; it also restores the original trace->nr after either kernel or user branch handling.

state_context.attacker_state_setup: The direct reproducer is absent. The artifacts establish only that the failing path uses a perf trace whose entry count exceeds the destination bucket's usable depth after skip handling.
data_structure_invariants: Stored post-skip trace entries must fit the bucket capacity computed from map layout and element size.
